name: Rakesh Chandra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rakesh Chandra is a former civil servant who writes in English and Hindi. His poetry collections include Moon is Black, Circle of Life and The Sunset Musings, alongside the Hindi collection Mere Shahar Me. His published work also extends to prose and translation.

“Beyond the Olive Branches” asks what familiar symbols of peace can achieve in a violent world. Olive branches and white doves give way to the recognition that peace depends on people themselves. The poem moves from the speaker’s wish to intervene towards an image of joined hands and mutual care.
